mock_result.customer_reply: Since your ERP upgrade on Saturday, the delivery date in your POs arrives as 08-28-2026. Retailer One's guideline requires CCYYMMDD, so 20260828. That is the only failing element on all 41 transactions. You can fix the export format, or we can add a rule that converts the date on the way in so nothing changes on your side. Which do you prefer?
